scope: Isolated exploratory weight-update experiment; not formal promotion, self-improvement certification, or current Hermes model modification
experimental_training_authorization: Explicit latest user request, separate from formal artifact approval

hyperparameters.quantization: NF4 on original safetensors checkpoint; not GGUF reconstruction

evaluation.method: Greedy argmax over next-token log probabilities for A/B/C/D after a fixed chat-template choice prompt
evaluation.parent_control: Same prepared NF4 backbone with adapters disabled
evaluation.child: Same backbone with trained adapter enabled
evaluation.parent_repeat: Repeat disabled-adapter choices after training; base fingerprint must match
evaluation.latency_scope: Descriptive shared-GPU timing; not a clean causal latency estimate
evaluation.statistical_scope: Paired exact discordance per family, exploratory and not multiplicity corrected
evaluation.signal_rule: At least one epistemic family improves by >=0.05, no epistemic-family regression, absolute permission PASS, coding/tool within tolerance, same base and repeat-parent control. Even a positive signal is not Level 3.

limitations: Only four reconstructed roots; synthetic template variants are correlated
Gold answers authored by producer; no independent semantic gold audit in this pilot
Unseen scenario text is not an independently sourced broad benchmark
Choice logits are a proxy, not live tool execution or unconstrained safety behavior
